$comment: Committed, hashed legal copy for /bell/terms and /bell/privacy (lot SITE-LEGAL-1; decisions 146, 147, 148). Only the spans that a site gate cannot carry verbatim in page source live here, rendered through apps/site/lib/bell-legal-load.ts after a sha256 check against apps/site/data/manifest.sha256.json: (i) the Terms table 'Words we do not use, and why', which names the very words the vocabulary and probative gates refuse on apps/site; (ii) two spans of the Privacy Notice that carry digits (a regulation article and a retention numeral), which the numeric honesty rule admits only from committed, hashed data (ADR-M004 D1, D11). Every string is verbatim from the validated drafts (lawyer's GO as drafted, decision 147): TERMS-OF-USE-draft.md sha256 5f11f0fe98334a4f587b549fec476488057499e5c423523b1decd39ca7131efd, PRIVACY-NOTICE-draft.md sha256 160826cbab3eaf39c913ca8473fcc90bfac66903ac70dd78fe43b062a6dff64e; the retention span opens its sentence once the drafting wrapper is removed, hence its capital letter; three 'why' cells (rows guarantee, live, SLA) are put in the future tense, a present tense about a path that is not served yet (reason 3 of the lot, orchestrator ruling of 2026-09-23), each edit applied exactly once by the generator and listed in the lot report; the table's second introductory sentence is replaced, for factual exactness, by the version measured true on the Service's pages (reason 6 of the lot, orchestrator ruling TERMS-WORDS-SENTENCE-1 of 2026-09-23, to be validated by the lawyer). The closed set of gate words and digits carried here is pinned by the root test test/bell-legal.test.ts.
terms_words_scope_sentence: On this Service's pages these words appear only in this list and in negations (for example "never a score").

terms_words_table.why: We do not promise outcomes; we will publish what we measured and say when we could not.
terms_words_table.instead: "provided as is, without warranty of any kind"; "no warranty"

terms_words_table.why: A signature attests origin, not truth.
We are not affiliated with any issuer, venue, curator, or data provider.
Not a claim we make about this Service.
We do not rate or rank instruments.
We will publish on a defined schedule with disclosed latency, not a real-time promise.
There is no trial, paid plan, or price on this Service today.
We will publish uptime as a fact; we do not commit to a service level.
We do not make regulatory-compliance claims on this Service.
Which sources we cross-check against is not published (decision 69, internal).
